big_case.notes: Fact-bound municipal zoning and medical-marijuana facility licensing dispute from Pontiac, Michigan. The Sixth Circuit affirmed summary judgment applying settled procedural due process, substantive due process, takings, and Monell principles, and the petition framed five generic error-correction questions without a circuit split.
